name: cc-routine
description: Event-driven routines for autonomous Claude Code sessions on GitHub. Implementer (issues.opened → focused PR; gate-conditional landing — squash auto-merge only where the target branch has required status checks, else the PR stays open) plus optional merger (pull_request.opened → six-condition fail-closed gate → gh pr merge --auto or one needs-you escalation). Author + label gated, repo-agnostic skills.
